facts.text: Find the treasure marked on the party's map.

Grimny says the map came from his brother Bral and the treasure is the dwarves' hoard. He says Bral probably hid it in the map's Dragon's Lair, a very small one-room cave that the dwarves scouted and found empty.

The dragon the party is hunting may be at the map's Dragon's Lair, where the treasure is probably hidden. Dunk suspects there is no dragon and that Bral only pretends there is one to keep people away.
facts.uncertain_reason: Dwarves found the cave empty, and Dunk doubts the dragon exists.

facts.text: Dr. Uriah can now read the label under one location on the treasure map per day. The labels read so far identify the Dragon's Lair and the Dwarven mine, and the unmarked location proved to be King Hogboon's temple ruins.
